name: Certified Cloud Security Professional

fee.note: U.S. list price for the Americas, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa; EMEA pays EUR 575.04 and the UK GBP 485.19. Taxes depend on the exam location.

exam.format: Computerized adaptive test (CAT) at Pearson VUE test centers: 100–150 multiple choice and advanced items in 3 hours. Offered in English, Chinese, German and Japanese (Chinese only in set windows).

scope: Vendor-neutral cloud security: cloud concepts, architecture and design, cloud data security, platform and infrastructure security, application security, security operations, and legal, risk and compliance.
requirements: To be certified: five years of cumulative full-time IT experience, three of them in cybersecurity and one in one or more of the six CCSP domains. A relevant degree or CSA's CCSK can waive one year (one at most); an active CISSP replaces the whole requirement. Without the experience, passing makes you an Associate of ISC2 with six years to earn it. Within nine months of passing, an ISC2-certified member (or ISC2, with proof of employment) must endorse the application.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: The current outline took effect August 1, 2026; check that prep material matches it.

Prices and taxes follow the exam location: ISC2 lists U.S. dollars for most regions, euros for EMEA and pounds for the UK. Pearson VUE charges U.S. $50 to reschedule and U.S. $100 to cancel. Confirm at checkout.
The fee is not refunded if the exam is not taken within 365 days of purchase.
Staying certified: U.S. $135 a year and 90 CPE credits per three-year cycle. Associates of ISC2 pay U.S. $50 a year and earn 15 CPE credits a year.
